references.observed: Operator gives 710 m crest length, 185 m height, 9 m crest and 60 m base thickness, 2053 m full supply, 150 m spillway and a separate 17 m tailwater dam.
Operator lists ten ungated bays and two low-level outlets.
Panorama shows the central overflow pier row, lower outlet house, curving road ties, plunge pool and the straight lower dam.
Downstream view shows water dropping through the ungated crest openings and the separate concrete lower basin structure.
The curved private road and the bounded Malibamat’so plunge pool identify Katse Dam.
